name: Proton VPN
author: Robin Marin
description: Connect, switch countries and change Proton VPN settings from the bar, wrapping the official protonvpn CLI

barWidget.description: Toggle Proton VPN, connect by country or feature, and change NetShield, kill switch and other settings

schema.label: Bar poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon checks NetworkManager for an active Proton VPN connection.

schema.label: Quick connect country
schema.description: Two-letter country code used by the on/off switch and right-click. Empty connects to the fastest server.
